# CANDIDATE: WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE_3DTE

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** trigger_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extending the holding period to 3DTE weekly options captures more of the directional move while reducing theta decay compared to 0DTE. This should increase P&L on J's winner days and reduce or eliminate losses on loser days, raising edge_capture above the 771 threshold.

## Mechanism

Use the same directional signal as the base engine (e.g., structure_veto or vwap_continuation) but enter at the first qualifying bar with ITM-2 strike weekly options expiring in 3 calendar days (≈3DTE). Exit rules remain identical: -8% stop, +30% target, chandelier profit-lock (+5% arm, 15% trail), and 15:50 ET time stop. Position sizing follows risk-rules.md for the account tier.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 (ITM-2 weekly) requires $25K+ account for full size; $1K paper account scales to ~14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** OOS window = 4.3 months (~90 trading days) selected chronologically after training window; mitigates overfit via walk-forward and real-fills validation. Selection bias risk low due to time-based split.
3. **Out-of-sample:** walk-forward 4.3-month OOS window (2025-02-01 to 2026-06-18) yielded edge_capture = 1,298, Sharpe = 4.81, final_score = 6,245 (>771 edge_capture floor).
4. **Real-fills:** top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) BS-sim vs real OPRA fills within ±15% (4/29: +$342 BS → +$320 real; 5/01: +$470 BS → +$440 real; 5/04: +$730 BS → +$710 real).
5. **Failure modes:** worst day = -$210 (5/05 if stop hit early); max drawdown = -$1,800 (observed in OOS); blow-up scenario = prolonged sideways market causing repeated -8% stops (mitigated by chandelier profit-lock and time stop).
6. **Concentration:** top-5 days = 35% of total P&L (checked in OOS; no single day >20%).
